summary: Phase 1 smoke test complete. Admin login works (nannsond@gmail.com/admin123). All 36 backend smoke tests pass (auth + 33 GET endpoints used by every page). All 21 sidebar routes load without crash or pageerror. Two pages (Kehadiran, Komisi) initially appeared to fail in rapid-fire navigation due to preview-ingress 429 throttling, but render correctly with a short delay between navigations — no actual app bug.

minor.issue: Returns 404 when logo not set (acceptable, but could return 200 with null to simplify client handling)
Non-fatal log: 'Storage init failed: 400 Client Error' from https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/init — does not block boot or any tested feature.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <option> (dev tooling injects span inside <option>). Not a crash, but noisy console error.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate <option> hydration warning on StokOpname — map p.name directly without wrapping component.
(Optional) /api/settings/logo could return 200 + null instead of 404 for cleaner frontend handling.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a single large file — consider splitting into routers per domain for maintainability.
Many report endpoints require query params with no defaults (/api/reports/daily?date=, /api/reports/monthly?year=&month=) — ensure frontend always passes current date to avoid 422s.
No rate limiting / 429 retry handling — all 429s came from preview ingress; frontend should implement retry-with-backoff for rapid navigation.
seed_data_creation: None created; repo seed auto-created products on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 goals met: login works, all 21 navigation pages load, backend smoke green. Admin creds in backend/.env. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_smoke.py (pytest, 36 parametrized tests). If testing more pages rapidly, insert 300-500ms between navigations to avoid preview-ingress 429.
rca of the issue: Initial Kehadiran/Komisi failures were caused by preview ingress 429 throttling after ~15 rapid-fire navigations. Confirmed by (a) no rate limiter in server.py, (b) both pages render fully when navigated with a 5s delay. Not a project bug.
